slides.title: Shoot once. Use everywhere.
slides.sub: How we made product imaging at least 50% cheaper.

paras: Every product image had to work on web and on mobile, in landscape and in portrait.
Older shots often had too little background to crop well for both.
slides.title: Why prepare every image by hand?
What we changed
items: One shoot per product in a flexible frame, wide and portrait.
AI crops each image and delivers it straight into the shop backend.
Older images with too little background get extended by AI.
slides.punch: Perfect on web and mobile, without a reshoot.

slides.caption: imaging workflow cost, at least
slides.lesson: The cheapest workflow step is the one you only do once.
slides.sign: I design products that cannot afford to fail.
